summary:
• Business Continuity Manager with 13+ years of experience in
business continuity management, disaster recovery, and DR
automation, with strong expertise in strategic planning, risk
management, crisis management, incident response and program
management aligned to business objectives.
• Led and supported BCM and DR exercises for clients across banking,
insurance, retail, telecom, automobile, and aviation sectors.
• Specialized in end-to-end Business Continuity Management, including
business impact analysis (BIA), risk analysis and management, crisis
and incident management, and BCM planning, implementation, and
testing.
• Experienced in planning and executing DR drills for scenarios such as
project DR, BAU DR, data center migrations, transition projects, and
BCM standardization/compliance initiatives; additionally supported
data center-level DR drills, major incidents, and DR automation using
the Kyndryl Recovery Orchestration tool.

jobs.role: Business Continuity Manager- DR and BCM
pre_date_header: Kyndryl Solutions – Business Continuity Manager- DR and BCM
bullets: Led BCM planning engagements for multiple banks, including defining BCM scope, objectives, policies, processes, roles and responsibilities, and developing end-to-end BCM plans.
Conducted annual Business Impact Analyses (BIA) for banks to define RTO, RPO, SLAs, and recovery priorities for critical business functions and applications.
Performed comprehensive risk assessments (process, facility, and third-party/vendor) for multiple stakeholders and recommended mitigation controls along with appropriate risk treatment plans.
Coached and mentored team members, regularly assessing knowledge and skills, also if there are gaps and implementing corrective actions.

Led a team in developing comprehensive DR Automation Strategy using Kyndryl DR Automation tool which have helped Bank to automate 54 applications average 80% and inline improve the Recovery time objective by 70% over manual execution.
Responsibilities involve identifying the automation possibilities in the limit of Kyndryl RO tool, DR automation, DR testing, BAU DR, Client management, Reporting.
Coordinated with IT and App teams to integrate DR initiative to achieve 99% success rate while executing 100+ DR drills each year.
Successfully planned and executed clustered DR drills, also supported emergency DR drills.
Spearheaded Business continuity and Disaster Recovery implementation for EBRD as part of Data center migration project.

Conducted business impact analysis collaboratively with various business units and departments, consolidates BIA results into continuity plans and exercises that test a department’s ability to carry out recovery plans.
Develop training programs guidance materials and conducts business continuity exercises
In coordination with IT and App teams, updated the DR Test plans and runbooks to align it with new Datacenter and conducted DR drills for same.
Also implemented the BCM best practices in line with BCM standards to achieve successful DR Drills and comprehensive documentation to support BAU BCM and DR exercises.

pre_date_header: Capgemini - BCM and DR Test Consultant
bullets: Delivered expert Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery (BC/DR) support in a multi-client environment as part of Capgemini’s DR/BCM-as-a-Service program.
Led and supported BCP and DR testing for high-profile clients including IKANO Bank, JLP, Cathay Pacific and Canon.
Led BCM planning engagements for multiple banks, including defining BCM scope, objectives, policies, processes, roles and responsibilities, and developing end-to-end BCM plans.
Conducted Business Impact Analyses (BIA) for various clients to define RTO, RPO, SLAs, and recovery priorities for critical business functions and applications.
Performed comprehensive risk assessments (process, facility, and third-party/vendor) for multiple stakeholders and recommended mitigation controls along with appropriate risk treatment plans.
Acted as the primary point of contact for DR projects at Capgemini, ensuring seamless coordination and execution of disaster recovery activities.
Provided DR support to clients during data center migrations, transitions due to end-of-support and transformation initiatives aimed at standardizing DR procedures for compliance.

Managed end-to-end DR project responsibilities, including scope identification, test plan development, runbook creation or updates, walkthroughs, change management, DR execution, test report generation, retrospectives, and handover.
Successfully managed multiple disaster recovery and Business continuity projects concurrently, consistently meeting deadlines and achieving key project milestones.

pre_date_header: Infosys Technologies – Telstra - DR Test Consultant
bullets: Served as the Operational Readiness Testing (ORT) and Disaster Recovery (DR) Consultant for the Telstra project, providing support for both ORT and DR testing at the project level.

Led effort estimation, defined and finalized the scope for ORT and DR drills, created test plans and test cases for ORT, developed runbooks for DR, conducted walkthroughs, and executed tests in alignment with project timelines.
Managed the preparation of test reports and facilitated test closures.
Provided client reporting and managed communications with stakeholders, ensuring alignment on testing progress.

jobs.role: STLC and Environment Management Tool Consultant
pre_date_header: Infosys Technologies - ERGO – STLC and Environment Management Tool Consultant
bullets: Consulted on the Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) and environment management procedures for ERGO.
Analyzed the organization’s current STLC and environment management processes, identifying gaps and areas for improvement.
Produced a Gap and Impact Analysis report comparing existing procedures with industry standards.
Recommended the implementation of an industry-standard SDLC framework and the adoption of Infosys’ in- house Environment Management tool for ERGO.

jobs.role: Operation Resiliency Testing/ DR Test Consultant
pre_date_header: Infosys Technologies - Daimler – Operation Resiliency Testing/ DR Test Consultant
bullets: Acted as the Operational Resiliency Testing (ORT) and DR Test Consultant for Daimler during the implementation of SAP on the cloud.
Defined the scope of testing in line with the project implementation plan, created detailed test plans, developed test cases for ORT, and created runbooks for DR.
Led walkthroughs, test planning, execution, and the preparation of test reports, ensuring alignment with project schedules.
Provided client reporting and managed stakeholder communications, ensuring test activities aligned with project timelines and objectives.

jobs.company: Infosys Technologies - Barclays – Operational Resiliency Testing
pre_date_header: Infosys Technologies - Barclays – Operational Resiliency Testing, DR Test Co-Ordinator
bullets: Acted as the single point of contact and coordinator for Infrastructure Readiness activities, focusing on DR and ORT as part of Barclays’ IT operations.
Led test planning, execution, and tracking, while managing stakeholders and resolving issues and problems across geographically dispersed teams.
Created test plans, documentation, and recommendations based on test findings and ensured adherence to client-specific procedures across teams.
Coordinated and executed various infrastructure tests such as build confirmation, resilience testing, backout testing, component failover, and backup/recovery scenarios.
Assisted in finalizing recovery procedures for DR setups and led simulated disaster tests, ensuring clear 'before, during, and after' processes for seamless execution.
